reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific hybrid workflow that actively trains an MLIP with targeted AIMD corrections in the near-melting regime (0.9–1.1Tₘ) to capture anharmonic and electron–vibration coupling effects for fusion free energies of multicomponent alloys. No passage combines active learning, near-melting AIMD corrections, and fusion free-energy prediction for high-entropy systems; the idea synthesizes elements from MLIP development, AIMD free-energy methods, and anharmonicity treatments into a new, testable protocol not suggested by any single source.
